input.title: Chris Adams CA DX 77 Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml for Men
input.descriptionHtml:
Chris Adams CA DX 77 Pour Homme is an eau de parfum for men, in a 100ml spray.

Scent notes

Top notes of citrus, bergamot, petitgrain, melon, apple, ginger and galbanum; a heart of vetiver, thyme, mint, lavender, geranium, nutmeg and clove; and a base of vetiver, sandalwood, cinnamon, amber and musk. Fragrance family: aromatic woods.

Details

  • Eau de Parfum, 100ml spray
  • Made for men
  • Brand: Chris Adams
  • 100% authentic, dispatched from the UK

How to use

Spray from 15–20 cm onto pulse points such as the neck, inner wrists and inner elbows. Don't rub your wrists together. Patch test before first use if your skin is sensitive.
